bait_content.title: Snap Refresh Requires Restart
bait_content.body: Pending updates for base snaps (core22, gtk-common-themes). AppArmor policies for Chromium and Snap Store are out of date; some permissions may be denied until the system restarts. Save work and restart to complete the refresh.
